svg.title: The 12-Layer Riding Tower
svg.desc: A whimsical twelve-layer tower: a pelican rides a bicycle at the base, balancing a scooter, a flamingo, a tricycle, a turtle, a unicycle, a crab, a skateboard and a tiny-limbed game controller. A bee chases a cat up the mast; at the very top they sit together as friends.

g.font-family: Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, Verdana, sans-serif
g.text: a twelve-layer balancing act — with a bee, a cat, and a happy ending
